verdict.rationale: Inngest documents cron-scheduled functions with timezone support, so the core cron-triggering part of the story is delivered. The evidence does not show cron-specific overlap policies, pausing or resuming a schedule, or a view of upcoming runs. The concurrency limits and run-level waitForEvent pausing are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented overlap policies for scheduled runs, schedule pause/resume, visibility into upcoming scheduled runs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I schedule workflows on cron expressions with overlap policies, pause/resume, and visibility into upcoming runs

citations.quote: Inngest's cron schedules also support timezones, allowing you to schedule work in whatever timezone you need work to run in.
You can create scheduled functions that run in any timezone using the SDK's createFunction()
Write functions in TypeScript, Python or Go to power background and scheduled jobs, with steps built in.
